orianna.why: The Ball is one shared positional resource every ability reads or moves: Q parks it at a location, W/R fire from wherever it currently sits, and E's only legal target with no allies is Orianna herself, which drags the ball away from the dummy and changes what W/R hit next. That persistent, cast-order-dependent position is shared state across the whole kit, not a one-off geometry assumption per ability, so it needs champion-specific logic; E's shield/resistances are otherwise pure defense.
